name: puzzleverse
description: Challenge Your Mind. Beat Your Best.
author: Sidhant Jain <jnsidhu30@gmail.com>

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env PV_DESKTOP_DEV=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs ."
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.desktop:win-all: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --win nsis portable --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:win-arm64: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win nsis portable --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.desktop:all: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --win nsis portable --arm64 --publish never
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
